title: Types of prescribed overlap transports and Hom continuity
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I→CommRingCat a diagram with colimit cocone c, i∈I, Z a scheme and t:Z→Spec(R_i) locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Assume the shared scheme and localized-open derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Fix j≥i; the hypothesis hstage says every pair of opens of Y_j admits k≥j (the index j itself suffices). Put Y_j=Z×Spec(R_j), X=Z×Spec(c.pt), and g_j:X→Y_j the canonical map. Let U,V be compact opens covering Y_j, A,B perfect objects on their open subschemes [def-pc-perfect-complex], E∈D(X), and φU,φV the given isomorphisms of their limit pullbacks with the exact restrictions of E [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. For EVERY k≥j there are exact coherent two-open comparison diagrams d_k [def-pc-two-open-comparison-diagram], functorial transports κU,κV and siteU,siteV, and θU,θV equal to the composites of these transports with the supplied φU,φV. Their overlap composites ψ_k(false)=γU.symm(A′)≫SP(θU)≫τU(E) and ψ_k(true)=γV.symm(B′)≫SQ(θV)≫τV(E) identify HW_k(SU_k(A′)) and HW_k(SV_k(B′)) with RW(E). For the categories C_k=D((f_kj^{-1}U∩f_kj^{-1}V).toScheme), the two objects F_k(false)=SU_k(A′), F_k(true)=SV_k(B′), the actual functors G_k=HW_k and target objects O(false)=O(true)=RW(E), the proposition perfectOverlapHomContinuityStatement asserts there is a DirectedPerfectHomSystem: transports preserve identity, composition and the conjugated limit image; all four kinds of limit Hom morphisms lift; and equal limit images eventually imply equality at EVERY later stage. No overlap isomorphism or inverse equations are asserted. The structure TwoOpenTransportData records the diagram, functorial transports, site comparisons and the pinned theta equations; perfectOverlapComparisonDataType is their exact dependent type. These are type definitions, not choices of inhabitants.
